physics-killer-03.title: Ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-amị
physics-killer-03.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-03.material: Ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-amị site n'izu ike n'ịdị elu $4\,\mathrm{m}$ n'elu ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ na-enweghị esemokwu, wee gafee akụkụ larịị siri ike (ogologo $5\,\mathrm{m}$, ịdị ukwuu esemokwu na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe edoro anya $11\,\mathrm{N}$), wee rigoro n'elu ọtụtụ aka nri na-enweghị esemokwu. Ọ bụrụ na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ ma e leghaara ọgbụgba ikuku anya, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ume ọkụ $Q$ e mepụtara n'akụkụ siri ike na ịdị elu kacha elu ihe na-arị n'ọtụtụ aka nri?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ na-amị site n'izu ike n'ịdị elu $4\,\mathrm{m}$ n'elu ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ na-enweghị esemokwu, wee gafee akụkụ larịị siri ike (ogologo $5\,\mathrm{m}$, ịdị ukwuu esemokwu na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe edoro anya $11\,\mathrm{N}$), wee rigoro n'elu ọtụtụ aka nri na-enweghị esemokwu. Ọ bụrụ na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ ma e leghaara ọgbụgba ikuku anya, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ume ọkụ $Q$ e mepụtara n'akụkụ siri ike na ịdị elu kacha elu ihe na-arị n'ọtụtụ aka nri?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.explain: Ume nkà mbụ $E_0=mgh_0=2\cdot10\cdot4=80\,\mathrm{J}$. N'akụkụ siri ike $Q=fs=11\cdot5=55\,\mathrm{J}$ na-aghọ okpomọkụ, yabụ ume nkà fọdụrụ bụ $80-55=25\,\mathrm{J}$. Ebe ọtụtụ aka nri enweghị esemokwu, site na $25=mgh$, $h=\dfrac{25}{2\cdot10}=1.25\,\mathrm{m}$. Ọ bụrụ na e leghaara esemokwu anya ma were na ihe ga-ari $4\,\mathrm{m}$, azịza na-ezighị ezi ②; ọ bụrụ na e were ume fọdụrụ $25\,\mathrm{J}$ dị ka okpomọkụ, azịza na-ezighị ezi ③; ọ bụrụ na e jiri $\frac12mgh$ kama $mgh$, a ga-enweta $2.5\,\mathrm{m}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ④).
